public_rationale: The joint announcement explicitly says the partnerships remained subject to final agreements. That supports Zitron's central point that the announced financing arrangement was preliminary. It does not establish that every MOU provision was nonbinding or that literally nothing had happened.
limitations: Support applies to the absence of a finalized financing arrangement, not to every rhetorical statement in the surrounding passage.
The announcement does not independently establish how much capital, if any, individual partners had already earmarked.
